articles.title: A Judge Hits Pause on the Giant Arch
articles.summary: A federal judge blocked construction of a proposed 250-foot arch in Washington, D.C., for 14 days, just hours after a planning commission approved it. Lawsuits over the project are still in court.

articles.title: Fewer Students, Emptier Classrooms
articles.summary: Public schools are losing students as birth rates fall and immigration enforcement rises. Los Angeles, Texas, and Florida have all seen sharp drops, and some districts may have to close campuses.

articles.title: One Small Word Steals the Victory Speech
articles.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, set to become the first Muslim American senator, delighted supporters by greeting Vice President JD Vance with 'JD, habibi' in his victory speech.
